description: Clear the browsing data of the site the tab is on: its cookies, its storage, and the shared cache — like a browser's per-site 'Clear cookies and site data'. Other sites keep their logins; browser::clear-browser-data wipes everything.

cache.description: Clear the HTTP cache (shared by every tab). Default true.

cookies.description: Delete the cookies the current page can see (its site's cookies). Default true.

storage.description: Clear localStorage / sessionStorage / IndexedDB for the current origin. Default true.

cleared.description: What was cleared, for the confirmation message.
